list.title: Roles
list.description: Manage authorization by responsibility, not by person.

create.title: Create role
create.description: A role is a named set of permissions. You can only grant permissions you hold.

delete.title: Delete role
delete.confirm: Delete role "{{name}}"? It moves to the trash and can be restored within the retention period.
delete.systemProtected: System roles are protected and cannot be deleted.
delete.confirmInUse: {{count}} users currently hold the role "{{name}}". Deleting it removes its permissions from them immediately; if you restore the role within the retention period, they get it back. To see who they are first, cancel and open the role details.
delete.force: Delete anyway ({{count}} will lose this role)

restore.successWithHolders: Restored "{{name}}"; its {{count}} previous holders have it again.
restore.escalation: This role carries permissions you do not hold, so you cannot restore it.

delete.title: Delete roles
delete.confirm: Delete {{count}} roles? They move to the trash and can be restored within the retention period. Roles still assigned to users are not deleted.
delete.ineligible: System roles and roles still assigned to users cannot be deleted in bulk.

duplicate.partial: Duplicated, but {{count}} permissions you do not hold were skipped.

permission.title: Manage role permissions
permission.description: Click a permission to grant it; the permissions it includes light up as "included". To remove a prerequisite, first remove the permissions that include it. You cannot grant permissions you do not hold.

skillTree.label: Role permission skill tree
skillTree.hint: Hover or focus a permission to see the prerequisites it includes.
skillTree.empty: Select a permission to see details
skillTree.blocked: To remove "{{name}}", first remove the permissions that include it: {{names}}
skillTree.unavailable: You do not hold "{{name}}", so you cannot grant it.
skillTree.superAdmin: super-admin implicitly holds every permission and cannot be changed.
